title: 咘咘喂老虎和冰雪城堡
title_en: Bubu Feeds the Tigers and Visits the Ice Castle

pages.text: 咘咘喂老虎和冰雪城堡
pages.text_en: Bubu Feeds the Tigers and Visits the Ice Castle

pages.text: 九月初秋的一天，咘咘和全家来到哈尔滨东北虎林园。
pages.text_en: On an early-autumn September day, Bubu and her whole family arrive at Harbin Siberian Tiger Park.

pages.text: 大家坐上安全的观光车，准备去看威风的大东北虎。
pages.text_en: Everyone boards the safe sightseeing bus, ready to see the mighty Siberian tigers.

pages.text: 咘咘和爸爸妈妈从车窗往外看，一只东北虎正在林边散步。
pages.text_en: Bubu looks out the window with Dad and Mom. A Siberian tiger is walking by the woods.

pages.text: 爸爸拿起长长的夹子，夹住一小块红褐色的虎肉。
pages.text_en: Dad picks up the long tongs and holds a small reddish-brown piece of tiger food.

pages.text: 咘咘和爸爸妈妈一起，用长夹子隔着车窗把食物递给东北虎。
pages.text_en: Bubu, Dad, and Mom use the long tongs through the bus window to offer food to the tiger.

pages.text: 东北虎叼走食物，慢慢走回树林。咘咘轻轻说：“谢谢你！”
pages.text_en: The tiger carries away the food and walks back to the woods. Bubu whispers, “Thank you!”

pages.text: 爷爷奶奶带咘咘去看圆滚滚的黑熊。黑熊正在大树旁找东西吃。
pages.text_en: Grandpa and Grandma take Bubu to see a round black bear, who is looking for food by a big tree.

pages.text: 外公外婆用彩色水果喂黑熊：红苹果、黄香蕉和紫葡萄。
pages.text_en: Grandpa and Grandma offer the black bear colorful fruit: red apples, yellow bananas, and purple grapes.

pages.text: 黑熊吃得开心，转着圈跳起舞来。全家都笑了。
pages.text_en: The black bear is so happy that it twirls in a little dance. The whole family laughs.

pages.text: 下午，咘咘和爸爸妈妈来到极地公园的冰雪馆。外面还是暖暖的初秋。
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, Bubu, Dad, and Mom arrive at the Polar Park ice hall. Outside, it is still warm early autumn.

pages.text: 进馆后，全家换上场馆提供的轻量防寒外套和手套。
pages.text_en: Inside the hall, the whole family puts on the venue’s light warm coats and gloves.

pages.text: 咘咘和爸爸妈妈走进冰屋，晶莹的冰墙像会发光一样。
pages.text_en: Bubu walks into an ice house with Dad and Mom. The sparkling ice walls seem to glow.

pages.text: 哇！咘咘看见一座梦幻的冰雪城堡，像童话里的城堡一样漂亮。
pages.text_en: Wow! Bubu sees a magical ice castle, as beautiful as a castle from a fairy tale.

pages.text: 咘咘和爸爸妈妈沿着冰路慢慢走，爷爷奶奶、外公外婆在后面欣赏冰雕。
pages.text_en: Bubu walks carefully along an ice path with Dad and Mom while the grandparents admire the ice sculptures behind them.

pages.text: 咘咘勇敢地从冰雪大滑梯滑下来，落地时开心地笑起来。
pages.text_en: Bubu bravely slides down the big ice slide and laughs happily when she lands.

pages.text: 在冰雪城堡前，七个人留下了一张暖暖的全家合影。
pages.text_en: In front of the ice castle, all seven family members take a warm family photo.

pages.text: 初秋的傍晚，咘咘和爸爸妈妈回到酒店。咘咘说：“今天有老虎，还有冰雪城堡！”
pages.text_en: On the early-autumn evening, Bubu returns to the hotel with Dad and Mom. “Today had tigers and an ice castle!” she says.
